Sonam Wangchuk's Fast Sparks Political Debate and Health Concerns

Activist Sonam Wangchuk's indefinite fast has drawn significant attention, with opposition parties criticizing the government and alleging an authoritarian attitude. Wangchuk's wife has raised concerns about his treatment and alleged police surveillance. Doctors report his condition is stable but medically vulnerable, with ongoing electrolyte therapy. The situation has garnered support from some public figures and continues to be a focal point of political discourse.
